# CLI

gtme has 13 verbs, in the order `gtme help --agent` prints them. Each verb's own page has its forms, its flags, an example from the docs, and where the docs use it. Everything a verb prints for a person goes to stderr; stdout carries data, so a script or an agent can read it.

| Verb | Does |
|---|---|
| [`gtme init`](/reference/cli/init) | Create ~/.gtme and the ledger |
| [`gtme secret`](/reference/cli/secret) | Store a credential in ~/.gtme/secrets (VALUE omitted = prompt, no echo) |
| [`gtme plan`](/reference/cli/plan) | Resolve adapters, validate every step's needs/uses and credentials, print the plan |
| [`gtme run`](/reference/cli/run) | Execute a pipeline |
| [`gtme query`](/reference/cli/query) | read-only SQL against the ledger |
| [`gtme show`](/reference/cli/show) | Print the current-value projection for one identity |
| [`gtme answer`](/reference/cli/answer) | Record a participant's answer for one pending human/* or agent/* step |
| [`gtme runs`](/reference/cli/runs) | List runs, or print one run's receipt (records/cost per step) |
| [`gtme freeze`](/reference/cli/freeze) | Print the pipeline.yaml that produced a run, reconstructed from its stored config |
| [`gtme groups`](/reference/cli/groups) | List groups with their entity type and derived character (members, added/removed/touched tallies), inspect one |
| [`gtme vacuum`](/reference/cli/vacuum) | Evict expired payloads from the ADR-030 cache tier |
| [`gtme adapters`](/reference/cli/adapters) | List installed adapters with their source and pin (.source.json) |
| [`gtme help`](/reference/cli/help) | Print this document |

## Exit codes

Every verb exits with one of these, so a script can branch on the number.

| Code | Means |
|---|---|
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | other error |
| 2 | validation or contract error: the plan, the file, or a value was refused |
| 3 | auth or credential error |
| 4 | rate-limited by a vendor |
| 5 | network error |
